original_task.name: Independent development validation of a serial multi-segment soft arm
original_task.source: Development task with fixed target, tolerance and scoring; historical tasks are unchanged

original_plan.expected_observation: Each evaluated structural candidate constructs a bounded static equilibrium with residual in the ~1e-9..1e-7 m range (all feasible under the 1e-5 normalized-residual rule); no candidate yields a residual materially smaller than the nominal, so the best mathematical candidate remains the nominal starting design.
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Frozen family-multisegment-dev task (target [.29,.035,.19] m, mount [0,0,.15], gravity -9.81 z, seed 17, 0.35 s, 0.01 s control, 0.0005 s physics, six independent 0..8 N ideal tensions, holding 0.30-0.35 s inclusive); frozen task-local-v2 protocol (input scale 8 N, output scale 0.01 m, 20 static iterations, 1e-5 normalized residual); immutable nominal source 4053cb...; candidates constructed relative to that single source; materials fixed at baseline, routing scales fixed at 1.0, controller/reward settings frozen.
original_plan.hypothesis: A legal structural change to the nominal near/distal1 geometry (segment lengths and section scales, materials fixed at baseline) does not materially reduce the bounded static target-equilibrium position residual below the nominal ~4.07e-9 m, because the nominal already constructs a target equilibrium essentially exactly. The search will actually construct and evaluate several canonical structural candidates to test this.
original_plan.interpretation: Mathematical proxy ranking is not task acceptance and the best mathematical candidate cannot be selected for confirmation. The result indicates whether any legal structural change is worth closed-loop (NMPC) evaluation or whether the nominal must remain the starting design.
original_plan.stopping_condition: The search exhausts its declared evaluation budget (max_evaluations=6) with the nominal retained as best, or a materially better feasible candidate appears; then the structural search branch stops and the honest outcome is recorded.
original_plan.weakening_observation: At least one legal structural candidate yields a target-equilibrium position residual materially smaller than the nominal (e.g. below ~1e-9 m), so the claim that the nominal sits at the proxy optimum is not supported.

original_plan.expected_observation: The NMPC episode completes 0.35 s without solver errors; the inclusive holding window 0.30-0.35 s shows tip position error < 0.01 m and tip speed < 0.02 m/s with all six tensions within 0-8 N, i.e. task accepted (order 1e-3 m and 1e-2 m/s, comparable to historical passing runs).
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Frozen family-multisegment-dev task (target [.29,.035,.19] m, mount [0,0,.15], gravity -9.81 z, seed 17, 0.35 s duration, 0.01 s control/sample, 0.0005 s physics, six independent 0-8 N ideal tensions) and frozen task-local-v2 protocol; frozen controller/reward settings; candidate fixed as the exact construction distal1_section_scale = 1.025 with lengths [0.16, 0.11] and baseline materials/routing.
original_plan.hypothesis: The model-selected legal structural change (distal1_section_scale = 1.025, lengths [0.16, 0.11], materials baseline, routing 1.0) is goal-based task-feasible under the frozen NMPC controller and the frozen family-multisegment-dev task, matching the nominal's holding position/speed thresholds.
original_plan.interpretation: This converts the saturated mathematical proxy into goal-based closed-loop evidence for a legal structural change. Success yields a passing development (not yet a confirmed design); failure means the structural change is not task-feasible despite being proxy-equal. Neither outcome is a superiority or optimality claim.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Stop after this single development execution returns. If it is task-accepted, freeze that exact result as the selected execution for two fresh independent confirmations; if it fails, retain the failure without repetition and reconsider the design/control route.
original_plan.weakening_observation: NMPC fails to complete, raises solver errors, or violates the holding position/speed thresholds or tension bounds, so this structural change is not task-feasible and must not be selected for confirmation.

original_plan.expected_observation: Both fresh confirmations complete the 0.35 s episode with zero solver errors, holding-window (0.30-0.35 s, inclusive) tip position error below 0.01 m and tip speed below 0.02 m/s, and all six tensions within 0-8 N, consistent with the development result (holding max error ~3.4e-3 m, holding max speed ~7.3e-3 m/s).
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Frozen family-multisegment-dev task (target [.29,.035,.19] m, mount [0,0,.15], gravity -9.81 z, seed 17, 0.35 s, 0.01 s control/sample, 0.0005 s physics, six independent 0-8 N ideal tensions) and frozen task-local-v2 protocol; the exact selected candidate, controller configuration and checkpoint are frozen; no design or controller changes during confirmation.
original_plan.hypothesis: The frozen development-passing solution (candidate core-920577b4 = distal1_section_scale 1.025, lengths [0.16, 0.11], baselining materials/routing; frozen family-multisegment-dev task; frozen NMPC controller and configuration) reproduces its goal-based task acceptance in two fresh independent nominal episodes.
original_plan.interpretation: Two fresh passes convert the passing development into an independently confirmed new structural design within nominal ideal-tension sampled simulation. This is not a claim of structural superiority, global optimality, robustness or hardware validity, and does not change the frozen task thresholds.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Perform exactly two fresh independent confirmations of the frozen solution and no more repetitions; stop once both return, retaining any failure.
original_plan.weakening_observation: Either fresh confirmation fails to complete, raises solver errors, or violates a holding position/speed threshold or tension bound; the failure is retained and the design is not a confirmed new design.

original_plan.expected_observation: The second fresh confirmation completes the 0.35 s episode with zero solver errors and holding-window tip position below 0.01 m and tip speed below 0.02 m/s, or it reproduces the holding-speed violation; either way it is retained as-is.
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Frozen family-multisegment-dev task (target [.29,.035,.19] m, mount [0,0,.15], gravity -9.81 z, seed 17, 0.35 s, 0.01 s control/sample, 0.0005 s physics, six independent 0-8 N ideal tensions) and frozen task-local-v2 protocol; the frozen selected execution 355698ec (candidate core-920577b4, distal1_section_scale 1.025, lengths [0.16, 0.11], baseline materials/routing) with its exact NMPC controller configuration; no design, controller or checkpoint changes.
original_plan.hypothesis: The frozen development-passing solution (selected execution 355698ec, candidate core-920577b4 with distal1_section_scale 1.025) will reproduce goal-based task acceptance in the second required fresh independent nominal episode, or reproduce the holding-speed violation; the first confirmation already failed on holding speed (0.0474 m/s > 0.02 m/s), so the design cannot be a confirmed new design regardless.
original_plan.interpretation: This completes the declared pair of fresh independent confirmations of the frozen solution. Because one required confirmation already failed on the holding-speed criterion, the new structural design is not confirmed; the pair is retained for honest reporting and no further repetitions are performed.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Perform exactly this one remaining fresh confirmation (completing the required two) and no more repetitions; stop and report once it returns, retaining any failure.
original_plan.weakening_observation: The confirmation fails to complete, raises solver errors, or violates any holding position/speed threshold or tension bound; the outcome is retained and no retry is attempted.

original_plan.expected_observation: A model-selected structural candidate would construct a target equilibrium, pass one NMPC development episode, and then pass two fresh independent confirmations of the frozen solution, establishing a new confirmed design distinct from the start design.
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Frozen family-multisegment-dev task (target [.29,.035,.19] m, mount [0,0,.15], gravity -9.81 z, seed 17, 0.35 s, 0.01 s control/sample, 0.0005 s physics, six independent 0-8 N ideal tensions, holding 0.30-0.35 s inclusive, position<=0.01 m and speed<=0.02 m/s) and frozen task-local-v2 protocol; single immutable nominal source 4053cb; declared speed weights and NMPC configuration otherwise frozen; ideal-tension sampled simulation only.
original_plan.hypothesis: A legal structural change to the near/distal1 geometry (lengths, section scales) can produce a new design that constructs a target equilibrium and is goal-based task-feasible under the frozen NMPC controller, selected by minimizing the bounded static target-equilibrium position residual at the target_equilibrium operating point.
original_plan.interpretation: Honest summary. (1) Mathematical structural search (problem 130a00a5..., objective target_equilibrium_residual at target_equilibrium, 6 evaluations, 5 structurally changed, termination evaluation_budget_exhausted): the proxy is saturated - nominal 1.5906e-9 m, best candidate 1.4170e-9 m, all feasible candidates 1.4-2.5e-9 m, far below the 1e-5 normalized-residual rule - so it cannot discriminate; near_length 0.164 gave 2.4588e-9 and two changes (near_length 0.156, and distal1 length-shortened variants) broke equilibrium construction (residuals 2.15e-3 and 9.83e-4 m, SLSQP iteration-limit). No material improvement exists in this subregion, so no better new design was established mathematically. (2) Actual structural-change evaluation: the model-selected candidate core-920577b4 (distal1_section_scale 1.025, lengths [0.16,0.11], baseline materials/routing; artifact f7d9033) passed one NMPC development episode (holding error 3.48e-3 m, holding speed 7.28e-3 m/s, terminal error 3.41e-3 m, 0 solver errors). (3) Confirmation: one fresh independent confirmation (ef33c5ca) is a valid failure solely on holding_speed 0.0474 m/s > 0.02 m/s (holding position 3.82e-3 m ok, terminal error 3.40e-3 m ok, force bounds ok, coverage ok, 0 solver errors). Because a required confirmation failed and the system refuses further confirmation ("confirmation failed or invalid; inspect evidence, no automatic retry"), the new structural design is NOT confirmed (confirmed=false, 1/2 confirmations, 1 failure) and no retry/success-hunting was performed. (4) RL: no run is recorded (empty training_summaries/runs/source_summary; status requires a recorded run id), so there is no usable published exact checkpoint and RL task acceptance is unmeasured - no impossible evaluation was requested. Limits: local proxies/finite Gramians/Jacobians are not design sensitivities; the passing development is not a confirmed design; nothing here establishes global optimality, structural superiority, robustness, hardware, real-time or material validity; frozen task thresholds and controller settings were not changed; historical/development evaluations do not count toward confirmation. Remaining requirement for a new confirmed design: a legal structural design plus frozen-controller route that holds tip speed <=0.02 m/s across two fresh independent confirmations; that design does not exist in the searched subregion, and the single plausible candidate failed the holding-speed criterion non-reproducibly.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Stop now: the declared proxy search is budget-exhausted and shows no better design; the one model-selected legal structural change passed development but failed a required fresh confirmation on holding speed; further confirmation is refused and repetition would be success-hunting; the milestone of a confirmed new design is not met and is reported as such.
original_plan.weakening_observation: No legal structural candidate materially improves the saturated target-equilibrium residual proxy (nominal 1.59e-9 m vs best 1.42e-9 m, both far below the 1e-5 rule; two changes break equilibrium construction), and the single model-selected passing development fails a fresh independent confirmation on holding speed (0.0474 m/s > 0.02 m/s).

limitations: Local unconstrained frozen Jacobians; finite Gramians do not establish unilateral bounded-input feasibility.
Open-loop authority does not establish closed-loop stability, settling, or real-time execution.
Numerical agreement is implementation verification, not physical model validation.
Saved non-equilibrium frequency curves are frozen-Jacobian resolvents, not measured steady-state responses.
Local mathematics does not establish nonlinear backend acceptance, holding-window compliance, or design sensitivity.
